literal.prompt: Какая династия правила Россией с 1613 года до Февральской революции 1917 года?

literalGroups.primaryGround: The Library dates Michael Romanov’s election to 1613 and says this began the dynasty (L323-L324); it says Romanov descendants held authority before 1917 and identifies the February Revolution (L353, L357). The Rurikids are explicitly the preceding dynasty. The official Spanish Crown, Versailles and Habsburg pages establish the foreign dynastic alternatives. Only Romanovs fit this Russian span.
literalGroups.locator: turn3view0 L323-L324, L353, L357; turn1view0 L4; turn1view1 L1910-L1913; turn1view2 L503-L508

literalGroups.literal: В 1613 году Земский собор избрал Михаила Фёдоровича Романова, положив начало династии. Романовы сохраняли власть до Февральской революции 1917 года.
literalGroups.primaryGround: The Library supports the 1613 election and beginning of the dynasty (L323-L324), authority in descendants before 1917 (L353), and the February Revolution (L357). Rewording removes the old unsupported abdication detail.

literalGroups.literal: Первым царём династии стал Михаил Фёдорович Романов, избранный Земским собором.
literalGroups.primaryGround: The note identifies Mikhail Fyodorovich as the first tsar of this dynasty and says the Zemsky Sobor elected him; the Library states these facts directly.

literalGroups.literal: Рюриковичей сменила династия Романовых в начале XVII века.
literalGroups.primaryGround: The note says the Romanovs replaced the Rurikids in the early seventeenth century; the Library describes the new dynasty as replacing the Rurikids on the historical stage.

literalGroups.literal: Испанскую ветвь Бурбонов основал Филипп V.
literalGroups.primaryGround: The Spanish Crown lists Bourbon among ruling houses of Spain; Versailles states that Philip V founded the Spanish Bourbon dynasty.

literalGroups.literal: Габсбурги удерживали титул императора Священной Римской империи с XV века почти без перерывов до 1806 года.
literalGroups.primaryGround: The Habsburg history page directly supports retention of the Holy Roman imperial title from the fifteenth century until 1806, with very few exceptions.

correctNoteNewFact.fact: Mikhail Fyodorovich Romanov was elected tsar by the Zemsky Sobor in 1613 and became the first tsar of the Romanov dynasty.
correctNoteNewFact.whyAdditional: The prompt and answer label identify the dynasty and period but do not give the first tsar’s name or the electing body.

absoluteDifficulty.audienceGround: For the broad Russian-speaking adult audience, the Romanovs are a central, widely taught ruling dynasty. The question asks recognition of this national-history house over an explicitly dated span; it needs no specialist chronology or multistep inference.
absoluteDifficulty.judgment: The Rurikids are a plausible Russian alternative; Bourbons and Habsburgs are recognizable dynastic houses but are tied to other European monarchies in the notes. All four options are actual dynasties of a comparable category. This is an audience judgment, not a survey result.
